content.text:
All three renders are done and verified.

**Files produced** (in the working folder):
- `square.png` — 1080×1080 (master)
- `landscape.png` — 1920×1080
- `story.png` — 1080×1920
- `card.html` — the source, one responsive template driven by `?size=square|landscape|story`

**Design**
- Dark `#0F1226` field with a violet radial glow and a violet accent bar along the top edge.
- Header: logo mark + hairline divider + "FIELDNOTES CONF 2026" in tracked-out caps.
- Portrait is a true circle (`border-radius:50%` + `object-fit:cover` + `aspect-ratio:1`) with a violet ring and soft halo — measured square at every size (196, 430, 440 px).
- Title uses a two-tone treatment (white lead-in, violet continuation) and wraps naturally to 4 lines in every format.
- Footer sits on a hairline rule: date/venue on one side, pill "Get tickets" button on the other (stacked and centered in the story format).

**Per-size layout**
- *Square*: stacked — header, portrait beside name/role, kicker + title, footer row.
- *Landscape*: two columns — title block left (auto margins vertically center it between kicker and footer), portrait + name/role stacked in a 540 px right column.
- *Story*: fully centered vertical column with a large 440 px portrait and centered title.

**Checks run**: a bounding-box audit against the card rect at each size returned zero overflowing or clipped elements, `document.fonts.check` confirms Inter loaded from the local `@font-face` (no fallback synthesis), and PNG headers confirm exact pixel dimensions.
